title: Opaque DXF section adapter capture bounds
mode: Local implementation slice with generated fast validation
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound the persistent adapter-owned copy made by addRawDxfSection.
Account group slots, string/binary values, section names, and ASCII source spellings.
Fail closed on record/group/byte/allocation refusal before DXF output publication.
Add generated deep-copy and boundary controls and preserve the raw-section CLI passthrough regression.

implementation.behavior: Capture failure is sticky and blocks DXF output preflight. The logical retained-byte estimate is not an allocator-capacity or RSS limit.

limitations: This bounds an adapter-owned DXF passthrough copy; it does not interpret arbitrary raw sections, prove DWG AcDs closure, establish ACIS semantics, or qualify a native consumer. All work remains uncommitted on top of the user's large existing worktree changes.
